name: Relationships
description: Directional character relationships: power dynamic, temperature, conflict, evidence

agentPrompts.label: Add or update a relationship between two characters
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-drama` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record the relationship I describe between the two characters — type, power dynamic, emotional temperature, conflict, and the evidence episodes — using the characters' canonical ids, not display names. If the relationship just changed (reconciled, betrayed, revealed kinship), update it explicitly rather than leaving stale state.

agentPrompts.label: Map the power dynamics in this story
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-drama` skill in this folder, then summarize the relationship map — who holds power over whom, current conflicts, and which episodes carry the evidence.
